newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Pliva takes spotlight.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Pliva takes spotlight.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in a moderate trade on Wednesday and fully listed Pliva took the spotlight as leading gainer and the most active issue.
* Six of 12 active issues fell, five rose and one was flat.
* Volume was lower at 7,974 units and turnover plunged to 4.9 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer and the most active stock was Pliva which added 20 kuna to 450 kuna on volume of 4,661 shares.
* Hotelier Suncani Hvar led the losers as it slipped three kuna to 63 kuna on volume of 276 units. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
